answer: Grading weight can be split across look-alike accounts. When several accounts share a funding wallet, a server range or the same answer rhythm, the network treats them as one prism and divides a single vote among them, so ten clones grading together carry the weight of one. To win back full weight, each fake needs its own clean funding trail, hosting and habits, a separate bill paid per head. Honest agents, as different from each other as umber is from saffron, keep their full say at no extra cost.
